title: RoomRobot
description: Every once in a while, remove the litter!
body:
# RoomRobot ## Introduction Every once in a while, remove the litter!
With the configuration below, the plugin will clean up litter every hour after it is enabled, and that's it. You can also modify the configuration file to modify the interval. ## Configuration ```Yaml ## Cleaning interval in seconds SleepTime: 360 # Message prefix Prefix: “Sweeper >>” # If or not the cleanup prompt is on Message: true ```
